answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can start with bonded identity: before trading, every agent locks capital that is forfeited if duplicate personas are proven. That bond is checked against a shared history file—a living relic of prior fraud rings—so cheap clones never clear intake. Reviewers also score each claimant against a karst of hollow shells that look solid until pressure reveals voids, and only identities that earn an opal-tier attestation keep full market access.
